## Summary

Implemented F002 verdict-vs-finding reconciliation in three places: (1) added `auditor_taxonomy.is_advisory_only_findings_set(findings, *, feature_id, saved_evidence_paths)` that returns True iff findings is non-empty AND every finding classifies to one of the four advisory v3 classes (env_reproduction_failure / evidence_shape_disagreement / spec_ambiguity / scope_overreach), with empty findings explicitly NOT vacuously advisory per D005; (2) rewrote `supervisor.dispatch_volley`'s `if aud_status == "blocked":` branch to take three paths — empty findings emit a new `blocked_no_findings` terminal + INBOX event (no auto-promotion since there's no advisory signal), all-advisory findings trip the existing `BreakerKind.ENVIRONMENTAL_BLOCKER` so the terminal becomes `stopped_environmental_blocker` plus a `verdict_blocked_reconciled` INBOX event documenting the override + classification, and substantive/mixed findings preserve the origin
